outcome: agreement between transvaginal ultrasonography and saline contrast sonohysterography in assessment of isthmocele
cohort: Non-pregnant women who underwent cesarean section
finding: Transvaginal ultrasonography and saline contrast sonohysterography are not in good agreement in the isthmocele diagnostics and the use of only transvaginal ultrasonography may lead to an underestimation of the prevalence of isthmocele.
